steps.content: First, your modern uniform clashes starkly with Graves's ornate, classical wedding dress, which makes her look like she's walked out of an oil painting. You two couldn't look more mismatched. This whole "destined lover" idea is almost certainly her one-sided fantasy.

Then, there's Graves herself—her obsession with marrying you is far from normal, and her behavior is wildly unpredictable. If you are truly experiencing the ghost story you just remembered, defying her would not be wise.

Finally, you're alone, unarmed, and have no memory of who you are. Worse yet, you're surrounded by numerous supernatural beings in this castle. It's clear that there's no way to fight back, and escape is impossible.
Though your memories are foggy, your mind remains sharp. Under the watchful eyes of these "friends," you quickly come to understand your predicament.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Have you decided? Just nod, and we'll begin the ceremony right away.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Then I'll wait until you agree. We have all the time in the world.
She leans against your coffin, her fingers trailing softly along its edge, her expression betraying an unsettling blend of obsession and longing.

If she doesn't care whether her marriage partner is alive or dead, she certainly won't be bothered by a little resistance. Graves has all the time in the world, but you can't afford to wait her out forever.
If the mere mention of the key elements in this ghost story was enough to awaken fragments of your memories, then immersing yourself in the story should trigger an even stronger response.
You look up and meet your bride's gaze.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: (If this is my only option to break this stalemate...)
